conclusion: The prototype was removed from the LAB between 18:00 and 18:18 via the unmonitored service corridor link (V01). A person in an orange work coat was visually documented with the object at SERVICE DOOR at 18:14 (V04, corrected from displayed 18:19 using V10 offset). Badge record D01 associates Eli Stone's credential with SERVICE_DOOR entry at 18:14, and internal message D02 shows project motive. However, due to documented identity limitations (D03), no responsible individual can be definitively identified. Badge records log credentials not biometric identity; coat colors identify appearance at specific moments only. The person in V04 could be Eli Stone using his own credential, someone else using stolen credentials while wearing an orange coat, or any combination thereof. Alternative explanations include legitimate transfer of the object before 18:00 or after 18:18 by a different party, credential theft and misuse by an unknown person, or misidentification of the person in V04.
